name: Sentry

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Exhaustion: Rakibin kritik vuruş gücünü ve tetiklenme oranını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Wither: Rakibin güç kazanma ve iyileşme etkilerini zayıflatır.
abilityDetails.Energy Vulnerability: Enerji Direncini azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen enerji hasarını artırır.
abilityDetails.Halt: Unstoppable şampiyonlar, vuruşlara sanki Unstoppable değillermiş gibi tepki verir.

signatureAbility:
Molecular Reformation
When Struck by a basic attack, gain an Indestructible Passive for 2 seconds. Cooldown for [90 - 30] seconds.
When Sentry enters a Solar Form with more than 20 Solar Energy, he pauses personal Debuffs on the Opponent for [0.1 - 0.5] second(s) for each Solar Energy over 20.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Sentry is Immune to all Nullify, Fateseal, and Incinerate effects.
Sentry converts any Critical Damage Rating bonuses into Attack Rating, increasing his Attack by up to +[9,973].

abilitySections.title: Bulwark Buff - Max: 20
content: Whenever Sentry inflicts a Debuff, gain a +[70.51] Bulwark Buff for 25 seconds.
If Sentry would gain a Precision Buff from the Dexterity Mastery he instead gains one of his Bulwark Buffs. This ability cannot grant more than 1 Bulwark Buff every 0.5 seconds.
While a personal Bulwark Buff is active, Mystic Champions' Combat Power Rate cannot exceed the amount they started the fight with.

abilitySections.title: Buff Conversion
content: On the final hit of a Special Attack convert all Active Buffs into a 15 second Passive of the corresponding type.
Any effects not listed are converted into Fury Passives.
Bulwark Passives have a +[144.74] potency. Max Stacks: 20.
Fury Passives increase Attack Rating by +[997.3]. Max Stacks: 40.
Regeneration Passives heal for +[2,041.23] health. Max Stacks: 20.

abilitySections.title: Solar Forms
content: Whenever Sentry converts a Buff into a Passive he gains 1 Solar Energy. When reaching 20 or more Solar Energy, consume all then change Solar Forms in the order of Base, Absolute Strength, then Brilliant Might.
While not in a Solar Form, Sentry's Basic Attacks inflict a [27.78] Exhaustion Debuff for 20 seconds. Max Stacks: 10.
Absolute Strength Empowers Medium and Light Attacks. While active, Empowered Attacks inflict a 10% Wither Debuff for 20 seconds. Max stacks: 10.
Brilliant Might Empowers Heavy Attacks. While active, Empowered Attacks inflict 2 +[305.56] Energy Vulnerability Debuffs for 20 seconds. Max Stacks 10.
All Empowered Attacks deal an additional 50% of the damage dealt as a burst of Energy Damage, and gain +[299.19] Attack Rating for each Debuff on the Opponent up to 99 debuffs.
When reaching 20 Solar Energy while in Brilliant Might, remove any Solar Forms, and gain a Reality Warp.

abilitySections.title: Reality Warp
content: Sentry gains 1 Reality Warp whenever he wins a fight and loses 1 whenever he is defeated.
Each Reality Warp increases the Attack Rating Empowered Attacks gain per Debuff by 50%.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: While at 3+ Reality Warp, Heavy Attacks refresh personal Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: While at 6+ Reality Warp, charging a Heavy Attack after landing a first Medium Attack inflicts a Stun passive for 0.75 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: While at 8+ Reality Warp, Sentry Starts each fight in Absolute Strength.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, inflict  a non-stacking Halt Debuff for 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, Sentry gains 1 of his Personal Fury Passives for each Debuff on the Opponent, up to 10.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Instead of Solar Energy, Sentry gains a Regeneration Buff for each Buff converted into a Passive by this attack.
Regen Buffs generated from this attack heal +[1,360.82] over 15 seconds. Max Stacks: 20.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Molecular Reformation
content: When Struck by a basic attack, gain an Indestructible Passive for 2 seconds. Cooldown for [90 - 30] seconds.
When Sentry enters a Solar Form with more than 20 Solar Energy, he pauses personal Debuffs on the Opponent for [0.1 - 0.5] second(s) for each Solar Energy over 20.
